frontier.hypothesis: A loop-SHAPE change (not a statement-order or spelling change) makes the class-C flip free, closing the last gap between the two basins.
frontier.mechanism: s12 eliminated every statement-level degree of freedom it could enumerate - group order (24/24), group spelling (8 forms), hoists (12 forms), wraps (79+79 positions) - and the flipped body's score never left the 20-29 band except by moving the store groups.
